items.title: Verizon Communications (VZ) Adds Charles Phillips To Its Board
items.summary: Verizon Communications (NYSE:VZ) has elected technology executive and private equity investor Charles Phillips to its Board of Directors. The Federal Communications Commission has placed a hold on Verizon's plan for automatic shutdown of copper-based telephone service in parts of New Jersey. The Board addition of Phillips and the FCC pause on copper service retirement frame broader questions about Verizon's technology focus and legacy network strategy. items.title: This Telecom Stock Just Raised Its Dividend by Nearly 15%.
items.summary: T-Mobile raised its quarterly dividend by 14.7% to $1.17 per share on Sept. 24, lifting the annual payout to $4.68 after adjusted free cash flow reached $4.8 billion in Q2.
